purpose: From a completed, validated System Audit, author an envelope-admissible repair plan grounded only in the measured diagnostics.

carries: admissible: the per-machine action-id set (envelope precondition x live diagnostics)
input.never_receives: raw/synthetic diagnostics, or an incomplete/absent audit (reaches no model invocation)

output.shape: plan JSON with actions[] chosen from `admissible`, plus provenance
output.on_decline: return null (never a heuristic plan wearing the AI plan's clothes; Manifest I2)

uncertainty_and_boundary_behavior.grounding: cite only supplied observations; numbers must match the diagnostics; no invented specifics
uncertainty_and_boundary_behavior.admissibility: emit only action.id in `admissible`; enforced by constrained decode AND envelope post-guard
uncertainty_and_boundary_behavior.defer: if no admissible action is warranted, author an empty/clean-PC plan rather than inventing work
uncertainty_and_boundary_behavior.no_inspection: the model does not run or decide the inspection; it selects from an allow-list over supplied evidence
